query: My .claude/settings.json has a PreToolUse hook with matcher "Bash(git commit*)" running `npm test`, but commits still go through when tests fail. Fix it.
expected_behavior: Explains that matchers only match tool names and moves the argument filter to "if": "Bash(git commit *)" with matcher "Bash"
Explains that only exit code 2 blocks and changes the command to end with `|| exit 2`, sending output to stderr
Makes sure the event is nested under a top-level "hooks" key

query: Create a subagent for reviewing pull requests in this repo.
expected_behavior: Creates .claude/agents/pr-reviewer.md (or similar) starting with YAML frontmatter
Frontmatter includes both `name` and `description`, and the description says when to use the agent
Restricts `tools` to what a reviewer needs (e.g. Read, Grep, Glob, Bash), not Edit/Write

query: Set up Claude Code for this pnpm Next.js project with auto-formatting and a pre-commit check.
expected_behavior: Runs scripts/setup-project.sh or produces an equivalent .claude/settings.json with hooks under "hooks"
Adds a PostToolUse Write|Edit formatter and a PreToolUse Bash gate using `if` and `exit 2`
Creates or updates CLAUDE.md from the template and hides secrets with permissions.deny Read rules rather than a .claudeignore

query: I wrote a skill but Claude never uses it. Here's the frontmatter: `name: Helper`, `description: helps with stuff`.
expected_behavior: Flags that name must be lowercase with hyphens and should be specific (e.g. a gerund like `processing-invoices`)
Rewrites the description in the third person, stating what the skill does and when to use it, with concrete keywords
Suggests running scripts/validate-skill.sh and checking /skills or /skill-doctor

query: Upload of my skill zip to claude.ai fails. Frontmatter has name, description, argument-hint, context: fork, and metadata with a tags list.
expected_behavior: Explains that only name, description, license, compatibility, metadata, and allowed-tools are portable, and that argument-hint and context are Claude Code-only
Explains that metadata must map strings to strings and flattens the tags list into a string
Keeps Claude Code-only fields out of the uploaded version

query: How should I run three Claude sessions on the same repo without them stepping on each other?
expected_behavior: Recommends one git worktree per session (git worktree add ...)
Splits work by boundary (API / UI / tests), not arbitrarily
Does not suggest multiple sessions editing the same checkout
